name: Investment Account
definition: Account between an investor(s) and a fund manager or a fund. The account can contain holdings in any investment fund or investment fund class managed (or distributed) by the fund manager, within the same fund family.

InvestmentAccountType.name: Investment Account Type
InvestmentAccountType.definition: Purpose of the account/source fund type. This is typically linked to an investment product, eg, wrapper, PEP, ISA.

OwnershipType.name: Ownership Type
OwnershipType.definition: Ownership status of the account, eg, joint owners.

Designation.name: Designation
Designation.definition: Supplementary registration information applying to a specific block of units for dealing and reporting purposes. The supplementary registration information may be used when all the units are registered, for example, to a funds supermarket, but holdings for each investor have to be reconciled individually.

ReferenceCurrency.name: Reference Currency
ReferenceCurrency.definition: Currency chosen for reporting purposes by the account owner in agreement with the account servicer.

AccountUsageType.name: Account Usage Type
AccountUsageType.definition: Specifies whether the account is used for investment or for settlement purpose.

UsufructPercentage.name: Usufruct Percentage
UsufructPercentage.definition: Percentage of usufruct that a person has on an asset.

OwnershipPercentage.name: Ownership Percentage
OwnershipPercentage.definition: Percentage of ownership that a person has on an asset.

InvestmentFundClass.name: Investment Fund Class
InvestmentFundClass.definition: Investment fund classes held in an investment account.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Part of the investment account to or from which cash entries are made.

SecuritiesAccount.name: Securities Account
SecuritiesAccount.definition: Part of the investment account to or from which securities entries are made.

InvestmentFundTransaction.name: Investment Fund Transaction
InvestmentFundTransaction.definition: Investment fund transaction which uses the investment account.

SidePocket.name: Side Pocket
SidePocket.definition: Separate account containing illiquid assets of a hedge fund portfolio.

InvestmentAccountPartyRole.name: Investment Account Party Role
InvestmentAccountPartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to an investment account and played by a party in that context.

DebitPortfolioTransfer.name: Debit Portfolio Transfer
DebitPortfolioTransfer.definition: Transfer process for which a debit investment account is specified.

CreditPortfolioTransfer.name: Credit Portfolio Transfer
CreditPortfolioTransfer.definition: Transfer process for which a beneficiary investment account is specified.

AccountForInvestmentFundProcessing.name: Account For Investment Fund Processing
AccountForInvestmentFundProcessing.definition: Order desk for which an account is specified.

RelatedPortfolioTransfer.name: Related Portfolio Transfer
RelatedPortfolioTransfer.definition: Transfer of a portfolio held on a nominee account.
